credits.overview: Chen Choushi meets Wen Qian at a dental clinic, sparking a brief romance. He reveals that he can see a number above a girl’s head, representing the length of their relationship—and for them, it’s only seven days.

credits.title: Brief History of a Family
credits.overview: A middle-class family's fate becomes intertwined with their only son's enigmatic new friend in post one-child policy China, putting unspoken secrets, unmet expectations, and untended emotions under the microscope.

credits.overview: Wei Li is the product manager of an Internet delivery company. His mundane life is carved up by excessive overtime and all-nighters. credits.title: Just For Meeting You
credits.overview: Xu Niannian and Yang Yi met at the most beautiful time in their lives, sharing an unforgettable chapter of youthful love and growth.

credits.title: Nowhere Float
credits.overview: After escaping from her hometown Cangshan to do house cleaning work in Shanghai, Xiaomei returns home. With distanced relatives, an estranged husband and a mother with Alzheimer's, she has mixed feelings. And she suddenly notices that her hometown has been re-named.

credits.title: Fearless
credits.overview: Starring Zhu as a magazine's chief editor, the 112-minute film tells the story of the protagonist encountering a string of weird things after she exposes a financial scandal. Despite facing a death threat, she manages to get the help from local police officers to crack down the criminals.

credits.title: Chongqing
credits.overview: In China, Xuie lives an impoverished life with her father who is far from helpful. She is living in Chongqing. One day, her father gets arrested because of prostitution and she is called to the police. One policeman comes closer to her and her mind is taken by him.

credits.title: Red Cherry
credits.overview: Based on a true story, this horrifying tale follows two orphaned friends as they struggle to survive during World War II.
